entries.execution_guidance: Begin with a common place, milestone or formative memory to create instant collective recognition
Structure the story from origins to current journeys, showing a continuing community
Use subtly warmer or softer archive imagery and crisper contemporary grading
Choose medium close-ups and shallow depth of field to prioritise eye contact and genuine expressions

entries.principle: Score a progression from personal memory to collective pride
entries.execution_guidance: Start with sparse piano or acoustic textures and layer warmth as the narrative expands

entries.principle: Use subtle tactile and room-tone ambience in interviews
entries.execution_guidance: Layer documentary room tone and quiet prop sounds beneath speech without distraction
Invite genuine recollections rather than over-rehearsed testimonial delivery

entries.principle: Capture micro-hesitations, laughs and spontaneous gestures
entries.execution_guidance: Allow pauses and unplanned reactions to convey emotional credibility

entries.principle: End with a soft, organic brand reveal
entries.execution_guidance: Transition gently from a warm closing image to logo and community CTA
Keep the brand organically integrated rather than visually forced

entries.principle: Use focal length to support emotional intimacy
entries.execution_guidance: Use longer lenses and shallow depth of field when foregrounding expression
